title: Get promotions (vouchers) — structuredContent
description: The `structuredContent` of the `get_promotions` MCP tool, for the T-05 inline row "Other vouchers and experiences available" (Figma MVP 1630:46397, card `Component 5`). 0.1.0 carries VOUCHERS ONLY, in `vouchers`; rate-discount offers (MVP row 1630:46392) will come as a separate optional `offers` array in a minor version, sharing `meta` and the card field names below (README decision 1). No recommendation: the MVP hides the `Rec` block (decision 2). Zero vouchers is a valid result, not an error (PRD AC-03). 0.2.0, provisional (2026-10-28): `details_url` may be a path, like the image fields (README decision 8).

property_name.description: The ENGLISH name of `property_code`, when sent.

location_label.description: What the search covered, in English, for the model's text: the property name, else the city, else the country name, e.g. "Singapore" (PRD §2.3 'resolved location label').

applied_filters.description: The input's filters echoed, when any was sent (PRD §2.3).

currency.description: ISO 4217: the ONE currency of every voucher `price` in this response (PRD AC-06). Required when any voucher has a `price`; omit when none has.

voucher_count.description: Number of vouchers matching the search: equals `vouchers.length` (the server sends every match, PRD §2.3 'one data packet'). PRD §2.3 'result count'.

asset_base_url.description: As T-01 to T-08: the origin relative image paths resolve against; default https://www.discoverasr.com.

vouchers.description: The vouchers, in the upstream display order (`sequence`). Empty when none match (PRD ER-01).

voucher.description: One `Component 5` card. `id`, `title`, `image_url`, `image_alt`, `scope_label`, `expiry_date` and `details_url` are the CARD FIELDS offers will reuse under the same names (README decision 1); the rest are voucher-only.

id.description: ← upstream `voucherProgrammeCode`, e.g. "TRIP50". Unique within the response.

title.description: ← upstream `voucherTitle` (in the API's language), else `voucherEnTitle`. The card title.

image_url.description: ← upstream `imageThumbnail`: a FULL URL, used as sent, or a PATH, which the widget resolves against `meta.asset_base_url` (default https://www.discoverasr.com), as T-01 to T-08. Omit when upstream has none; the card shows its placeholder (PRD EC-08).

image_alt.description: ← upstream `altThumbnail`. The image's alt text; the widget falls back to `title`.

scope_label.description: Where the voucher can be used, composed by the server in English for the card's location line (MVP 📍; README decision 6): one property → its name ("lyf Funan Singapore"); several properties → their distinct city names, in first-seen order, joined by ", " ("Singapore, Jakarta", PRD EC-03); country-wide → the country names. Omit when upstream gives no scope.

scope_level.description: ← upstream `applicableLevel`: "property_specific" → "property", "country" → "country". Tells the model whether `property_codes` limits the voucher.

property_codes.description: ← upstream `propertyCode[]`, duplicates and empty values removed, upstream order kept. Values are the upstream codes verbatim (upstream has non-numeric ones such as "CN1178").

country_codes.description: ← upstream `countryCode[]`, empty values removed (README open item 5).

expiry_date.description: ← upstream `expiryDate`, as YYYY-MM-DD. The card's "Offer ends: …" line. OMIT when upstream sends null: the card then shows no end date, never an invented one (decision 7).

details_url.description: ← upstream `voucherUrl`: a FULL URL ("https://…"), used as sent, or a PATH starting with one "/" ("/en/member/buy-experiences/…"), to which the widget adds its configured website domain (`VITE_SITE_ORIGIN`, default https://www.discoverasr.com; README decision 8). Either way the doubled "/" upstream sends after the host ("…capitaland.com//en/…") is collapsed. "View details ↗" opens it; the user buys there (PRD 'Redemption always finishes off-platform').

category.description: ← upstream `category` verbatim, e.g. "package", "cash" (PRD OQ-02). Not on the card; what `voucherCategory` matches.

price.description: The voucher's purchase price in `meta.currency` (MVP "999,999,999 SGD"). Source upstream field and currency to be confirmed by MuleSoft (README open item 1: `promoPrice` carries no currency). Omit when the voucher is bought with points only.

points.description: The ASR points the voucher costs (MVP "999,999,999 Points", or "or use N ASR points" next to a `price`). Source upstream field to be confirmed (README open item 1). Omit when the voucher cannot be bought with points.

remaining.description: ← upstream `inventory`: vouchers left. With `is_low_stock` it makes the card's tag "Only N left!" (MVP).

is_low_stock.description: True when the server judges `remaining` low enough for the "Only N left!" tag: `inventory` ≤ upstream `urgencyTrigger` (README decision 5, meaning to be confirmed by MuleSoft, open item 3). The widget shows the tag only when true AND `remaining` is sent.

description_text.description: ← upstream `description` as PLAIN TEXT: HTML tags removed, entities decoded, paragraphs joined by a blank line. For the model only; not on the card (decision 9). Omit when upstream repeats the code (e.g. "Chinavoucher") or sends nothing.
